::: {.obsidian-non-compete}
:::

State the background in one paragraph. Name the role, the reason
for the restriction, and the legitimate business interest.

# Restriction

State the restricted activity: the sector, the geography, and the
period. Write the restriction so it goes no further than the
business interest requires.

# Non-solicitation

State the restriction on soliciting customers and employees. Name
the customers covered and the period.

# Consideration

State the consideration for the restriction. Name the payment or
the benefit provided in return.

# Enforcement

State the enforcement terms: injunctive relief, severability, and
the law that governs the agreement.
